# Blackpaw Document Templates

These are the first production specimens built from the approved Blackpaw Brand
Foundation. They establish shared structure before format-specific Word, Google
Docs, PowerPoint and Slides templates are produced.

## Available

- [Universal HTML document](./blackpaw-document.html) — browser and
  HTML-to-PDF specimen with all five expression modes.
- [Authoring skeleton](./document-skeleton.md) — content-first source for reports,
  proposals, SOPs, PRDs and decision documents.

## Choosing a mode

| Mode | Use |
|---|---|
| Clear | Default; reports, proposals, SOPs, letters and training |
| Authority | Board, governance, security and major enterprise material |
| Human | Culture, people, customer stories and announcements |
| Precision | Technical, financial, audit and architecture material |
| Signature | Covers, launches and rare ceremonial brand moments |

Clear is the default. Choose another mode because the audience and purpose call
for it, never merely for variety.

## Required metadata

Every governed document carries a title, purpose, owner, version, status, issue
date and review date. Add confidentiality where the material requires it.
